notify.n_blocked_done.back: “{}” was played and the call was cut. AI was not used.

notify.ap_dt_fmt.note: fixed: Changed to 12-hour %-I:%M %p. Appointment times use a 24-hour clock, but people in India normally write times as 12-hour with AM/PM (the English source uses %-I:%M %p), so this should be a 12-hour format.

notify.ap_end_fmt.note: fixed: Changed to 12-hour %-I:%M %p. Appointment end time uses a 24-hour clock, but people in India normally write times as 12-hour with AM/PM (the English source uses %-I:%M %p), so this should be a 12-hour format.

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I can hear you. Go ahead.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you on the line?

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh yes, there's one more question.

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one minute", "wait a moment", "let me have a look", "hold on"
call.speech.no_wait.note: fixed: Reduced to only the quoted local phrases. The text is a full 'Never say ...' sentence, but the program already wraps this field in its own prompt text ('in <language>: {no_wait}'), so it should hold only the quoted phrases meaning 'just a sec' / 'give me a moment' / 'let me see'.

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you have dialed is not available right now. Please try again later.
call.speech.unavailable.note: Standard operator wording; the exact local phrase may differ.

call.speech.preview.back: ["Hello?", "Oh, a parcel? Yes, put it outside the door, thank you very much.", "Alright, namaste."]

call.speech.closing.back: verified=false; farewells: [goodbye, we'll meet again, we'll meet again, we'll talk again, have a good day, bye bye]; wrapups: [alright, let's hang up now, we'll talk later, that's all, alright, we'll be going]; ends: ["Alright, thank you, goodbye.", "Alright, we'll meet again.", "Goodbye"]; not_ends: ["Hello, this is Rahul speaking.", "Hello, there is a parcel for you, are you at home?", "Shall we talk later, I still have one more question to ask right now?"]
call.speech.closing.note: fixed: Wrapups now gender-neutral (rakhte hain/chalte hain) and first ends example now says alvida. Wrapups 'ठीक है अब रखता हूँ' and 'अच्छा चलता हूँ' have masculine verb forms only, so a woman's 'रखती/चलती हूँ' would not match (the pack otherwise aims for gender-neutral wording), and the first 'ends' example contains none of the listed farewells or wrapups.

console.f_language_h.back: The language in which the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: Language of notifications and summaries for you to read. Doesn't change the AI's language with callers.

console.f_simlang_h.back: Only needed when a phone has a SIM from another region: calls to that SIM start in the language you pick here. Needs the phone app 1.0 or newer.

console.sl_empty.back: Nothing set: every call starts in the language selected above.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if you are speaking yourself, without promising anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key from Google AI Studio

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: Enter a Webhook URL (Channel settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks -> New Webhook -> Copy Webhook URL) or bot token + channel ID; one suffices. For DMs, put your own ID instead of channel ID. Chat commands: Enter bot token and channel ID, and enable Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: Copy an Incoming Webhook URL (Mattermost too) or enter bot token + channel ID; one suffices. Chat commands (Slack only): Enable Socket Mode, then enter bot token (xoxb-), app-level token (xapp-), and channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console -> your Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify shut down in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave server blank for ntfy.sh. A token is only needed for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps -> Create application, then copy its token. Server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on your iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. Leave server blank for the public server.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net to get an API token. Your user key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In a WeCom group: add a group bot, then copy its Webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings -> Bots -> Add custom bot and copy the Webhook URL. If "Sign" is selected in security settings, paste the secret (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings -> Bots -> Add bot -> Custom bot, then copy the Webhook URL. Do not enable signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: From the ServerChan website, copy your SendKey.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), the sending account's access token, and the ID of a room joined by that account (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App passwords). Not your regular password.

console.hint_apprise.back: Your Apprise API server's notification URL, such as http://host:8000/notify/KEY. Tags determine which of its services receive messages.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST with event, title, body, and data. Useful for n8n, Home Assistant, or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: channel's ... menu -> Workflows -> "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", complete the steps and copy the resulting URL. Old Office 365 connectors have been retired.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: Open space -> Apps & integrations -> Webhooks -> Add webhook, then copy its URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration -> Workspace -> Integrations -> New -> Incoming: enable it, pick a channel, and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings -> Bots -> add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter its email and API key as email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more emails for direct messages.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or enter someone's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, username and app password (Settings -> Security) written as user:password, and the conversation token (the last part of the conversation link).

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration -> Incoming Webhooks -> Create, then copy the Webhook URL. Using the http:// address with port 5000 on your local network avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+...), and recipients (comma-separated numbers or group IDs).

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com -> Settings -> Account -> Create Access Token. Leave target blank to send to all your devices, or enter a device ID or email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. Entering a group code sends messages to that group; leaving it blank sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key, and copy it. Leave server blank for the public server.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: grab a simple push token (SPT_...) from the WxPusher website with no target. Or enter your app's appToken (AT_...) along with comma-separated user IDs (UID_...) or topic IDs.

console.hint_chanify.back: Create a token for this sender in the Chanify app and copy it. Leave server blank for the public server.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://...:465. The login is also the sender. Use an app password if your service offers one.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile -> Security), and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (listed under Developer tools -> Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks -> Documentation shows your key. Create a "Webhooks: Receive a web request" applet with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 is the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Blank = address shown in gray; enter your own address for use with Docker or opening from outside home.

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call, the AI writes a short summary. Usually nothing needs to be set here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any OpenAI-compatible service will work, such as https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: Uses your Gemini key by default. Choose "Other service" for another service.

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date comes up in a call (delivery, appointment), an “Add to calendar” link appears with the summary.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to schedule a time, the AI does not say yes right away; it says it will check and get back to them. Then you press Accept or Decline under “To-do” on the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After you decide, the phone that picked up sends a message to the caller (mobile numbers only). Off: the AI calls them back instead.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: message on mobile, AI callback on landline. No reply is sent to hidden numbers and those that cannot be called back (foreign, toll-free, etc.).

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with "thinking" in their name. "Low" gives the fastest reply.

console.ph_seen.back: Seen earlier, not connected right now

console.ph_none.back: Connect a phone with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging, and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept "Allow USB debugging?".

console.ph_offline.back: Offline: unplug the cable and plug it back in.

console.ph_noapp.back: Bageo app is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: USB link is active and app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: USB link is not ready yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off_d.back: Instead, phones connect to Bageo via the network.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones cannot be set up automatically over USB. Install Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add your key so that the AI can speak.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI what name callers use for you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions in “About you” so the AI speaks like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: No phone is connected yet. See “Phones” on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a notification channel to get call summaries on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: This requires a Gemini key or another summary service.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Call your phone's number to try it out.

console.ev_vm_end_max.back: The message hit the time limit

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: Caller does not need a reply

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: No reply on how to respond

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No reply when reading back contact info

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: Caller said the contact info was wrong

console.ev_gemini_fail_to_voicemail.back: AI failed, call went to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: No audio came from AI, call went to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: AI voice could not play, call went to voicemail

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: Arrived during another call, turned back as busy

console.ev_ivr_hangup.back: Recording or voice menu: call disconnected

console.err_no_audio.back: This call does not have that kind of recording.

console.err_http_error.back: The service responded with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported an issue in the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use an unencrypted room.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo will not send to this address. Enter your own address for your notification service.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can open the web console at http://name.local. Letters, digits, and hyphens (-) only. Blank = off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: Scan the code with your phone's camera to open the web console there.

console.cu_local.back: Only this computer is able to open this address.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code for the web console address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to your home screen. Next time, just press the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add into Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add onto Home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: Install icon on the right of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some older Android phones) should use this:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: rings, AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app on this phone to switch from here

console.ph_to_ai.back: Allow the AI to answer again

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: Incoming calls on this phone won't be answered by the AI anymore. It will ring like a normal phone for someone to pick up. You can switch back anytime.

console.ph_now_normal.back: This is now a normal phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: AI answers on this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: In a call: change after it finishes

console.pm_err_busy.back: Phone is still finishing the previous change

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: Phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: Phone could not change its default phone app

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: Phone could not change its call screening setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: Phone could not change Do Not Disturb

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: Phone could not turn its ring volume back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: Phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: Phone app is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: Outcome is not confirmed yet. Refresh this page shortly.

console.pm_err_failed.back: Something went wrong on the phone

console.pill_all_normal.back: All phones are in normal phone mode

console.er_new.back: Ask AI to make a call

console.er_new_d.back: The AI places the call, handles the task, and tells you how it went. During the call, you can read along and tell the AI what to do at any time.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type a name to search contacts, or enter a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: No contact with this name. You can also type a number directly.

console.er_need_pick.back: Pick a contact from the list, or enter a phone number.

console.er_task_ph.back: e.g.: Book a non-smoking table for 4 under the name Sharma tomorrow at 7 PM; if 7 PM isn't free, 7:30 to 8 works too. Or: Ask whether Saturday or Sunday has time for dinner this weekend

console.er_task_h.back: Describe what you want done and what you can accept. If unsure during the call, the AI will ask you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your behalf as your assistant.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (any free line that can call this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (normal phone mode, AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone in normal phone mode cannot place calls on the AI's behalf. Switch it back to “AI answers” on the System page.

console.er_pre_d.back: Add these so the AI doesn't have to pause and ask during the call.

console.er_pre_sim.back: Use the number of this line

console.er_started.back: Handed over to the AI. It is calling right now.

console.er_queued.back: Queued. The AI will call as soon as a phone is free.

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what you want done. The AI will call, handle it, and tell you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If nobody picks up or the line is busy, calls again every minute (up to 30 times).

console.er_redial_wait.back: Redial until answered: no answer on attempt {n}, will call again at {time}

console.er_live_wait.back: Dialing, waiting for them to answer…

console.er_live_none.back: No one has said anything yet.

console.er_watching.back: You are watching: if in doubt, the AI will ask you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time is up, the AI will now decide on its own

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g.: Tell them 8 PM works too

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI will end the call immediately. The task might not be finished yet.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: The other party did not confirm

console.er_options.back: Their options. Pick one and the AI will call back to let them know:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply and have AI call again

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI will call {who} again and give this answer.

console.er_delete_b.back: This will be removed from this list. Call records will remain.

console.er_err_bad_number.back: That number does not look right.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (emergency, special, or premium-rate number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: None of the phones has a SIM that can call numbers in this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not taken any calls yet, so the system does not know which SIMs are in it. Call it once, then try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what task the AI should handle.

console.er_err_task_too_long.back: This is too long: maximum 1,000 characters.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No AI phone is available right now (none is connected, or all are in normal phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: That AI call or contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is currently queued or in progress. Try after it finishes.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The call has already ended, so the AI cannot pass this along.

console.f_er_identity_h.back: How the AI introduces itself when calling on your behalf. This can also be chosen separately for each call.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: Whitelist (family and friends; can be connected to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: Stall list (AI wastes their time right from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How incoming calls from this number should be handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Pick who can reach you and when. It does not replace emergency services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Do not answer: send straight to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: AI answers, connects to you when urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: When something is urgent, the phone calls you on this number.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: When set, a password is asked when opening the web console (once per browser). Needed to open the web console on your phone or another computer.

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you will open this web console from outside your home network. You can change it later in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser will remember it. You will be asked again on a new device.

console.pw_setup_short.back: Password must have at least 8 characters.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel, write who may send commands, else nobody can. Leave blank in DMs. Your ID: enable Developer Mode, right-click your name -> Copy User ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel, write who may send commands, else nobody can. Leave blank in DMs. Member ID: open profile -> ⋮ -> Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room with others, write who may send commands, else nobody can. Leave blank in a room with just you and the bot. Matrix IDs look like @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: View calls, have the AI place calls, and manage tasks to do right from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" to see commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: View calls, have the AI place calls, and manage tasks to do right from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" to see commands.

console.ev_ai_errand.back: Call on your behalf by AI

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_merged.back: Urgent: connected you with the caller

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: AI left the call while calling you

console.urg_why_phone.back: Phone could not place the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write down what you want to say.

console.er_err_text_too_long.back: This is too long. Please shorten it.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: That question has already been answered or timed out.

console.d_del_call_b.back: Its summary, transcript, and recording will be deleted forever.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All finished calls and their recordings will be permanently deleted. Ongoing calls will remain.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait until the call ends before deleting this.

console.ph_forget_b.back: Removes this offline phone from the list. Past call records will remain.

console.err_device_online.back: Disconnect this phone before removing it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait until the ongoing call on this phone finishes.

console.bl_mode.back: When someone on the blacklist calls:

console.bl_voice_link.back: Choose the voice for the blocked-call announcement

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: Only blacklist numbers can end with *, and there must be at least 3 digits before it excluding leading zeros.

console.sms_empty_d.back: When the SMS forwarder is running, messages arriving on your phone show up here.

console.sms_pick.back: Select a conversation, or tap "New message".

console.sms_no_line.back: No phone can send messages right now.

console.sms_no_reply.back: You cannot reply to this sender.

console.sms_err_old_app.back: This phone's app is too old to send messages.

console.sms_err_permission.back: The phone app lacks permission to send messages. Grant permission on the phone.

console.sms_err_generic.back: The phone could not send this.

console.sms_err_number.back: Verify the number and try again.

console.sms_err_sim_not_found.back: The selected SIM card is not in the phone.

console.f_keep.back: How many days to keep records

console.f_keep_h.back: Calls and recordings, messages, calls by AI, and to-dos older than this are removed automatically.

console.f_phone_wifi.back: Phones can connect via Wi-Fi too

console.f_phone_wifi_h.back: On: once linked via USB, a phone keeps working on Wi-Fi after unplugging. Off: USB only.

console.f_repair_h.back: Use this if a phone was lost or used by someone else.

console.repair_b.back: Wi-Fi phones will be disconnected. Plug each phone in over USB once again to reconnect.

console.repair_done.back: Phones re-paired. Plug each Wi-Fi phone in over USB once.
